annotations.title: Find a company by name or website

description: Find a company the buyer names, by its English or Chinese name or its website (e.g. 'Bangli Medical', '浙江邦立医药用品有限公司', 'ykbangli.com'). Searches the Chinese suppliers here and companies known only from government records (refs F…, FDA-registered sites with no supplier profile; refs C…, makers named on Chile's 2025 import declarations). Returns each match's name, what it matched on, its self-declared type and profile for suppliers, and on_record: government records with source links. No match is not evidence against a company. Spends one search.

name.description: The company name as the buyer gave it, English or Chinese, or a website

website.description: The company's website or email domain, if given
